Dear Bidder,
The International Labour Office (hereinafter the “ILO”) is pleased to invite your company to submit an offer for this RFQ.
To enable you to prepare and submit a bid, please refer to the attached Annexes in the attachment area.
The ILO must receive your offer no later than the deadline specified at the ILO e-Sourcing Platform (Jaggaer). Late offers shall be rejected.
You may submit an offer to the ILO provided that your organization is qualified, able, and willing to deliver the goods, works, and/or services specified in this RFQ.
Participation in this RFQ indicates acceptance of the Terms and Conditions applicable to ILO Contracts provided as a link in Annex IV. Please note that non-conformity with the Terms and Conditions applicable to ILO Contracts (Annex IV) or the additional contractual conditions stated in section 2.6 can impact the evaluation of an offer. In addition, failure to comply with the requirements of this RFQ and its Annexes may render a bid ineligible for consideration.
In accordance with Article 2.2 in Annex I, bidders must upload all components of their offer before the submission deadline through the ILO e-Sourcing platform. Once the submission deadline has expired, the system will block any further upload even if partially completed. Whenever the use of the ILO e-Sourcing Platform is not possible, bidders should promptly contact ILO through the designated email: procurement@example.org
We look forward to receiving your offer.
Best regards,
ILO Procurement

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

agencies.description: Publishing UN organizations: an abbreviation as shown on UNGM (`UNDP`, `UNICEF`, `WFP`, case-insensitive) or a numeric UNGM agency id (`1` = UNDP). Resolved against the search page's organization list; an unknown value is invalid_input.

countries.description: Beneficiary countries or territories: the English name as listed on UNGM (`Kenya`, `Lao People's Democratic Republic`, case-insensitive) or a numeric UNGM country id (`2403`). An unknown value is invalid_input.

deadline_from.description: Earliest deadline date, ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`. The site's own default search uses today's date here; when omitted, no lower bound is sent. Pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$.

description.description: Text the notice description must contain.

include_expired.description: `true` also returns notices whose deadline has passed (the site's IsActive=false). Default: active notices only.

notice_types.description: Types of opportunity, the site's enum values.

page.description:
1-based page of 15 rows; `next_page` in the output gives the next one.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 1000; default 1.

sort.description:
Sort order. Default: soonest deadline first, as on the site.

Provider reference: allowed values ["deadline_asc", "deadline_desc", "published_desc", "published_asc"]; default "deadline_asc".

title.description: Text the notice title must contain (the site's Title filter).

unspsc_ids.description: UNSPSC node ids (`node_id` from search_unspsc, not the 8-digit UNSPSC code).

200.description:
Search UN procurement notices (procurement opportunities) on UNGM, 15 per page, with the site's filters: title, description and reference text, published and deadline date ranges, publishing agencies (abbreviation or id), beneficiary countries (name or id), UNSPSC node ids and notice types; active notices only by default. Each row carries the notice id, title, agency abbreviation, notice type, reference, beneficiary country, publication date and the deadline as shown (agency local time with its GMT offset) plus a derived UTC instant.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `records` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agency` | string | Publishing organization abbreviation as shown (e.g. `UNDP`). |
| `beneficiary_country` | string | Beneficiary country or territory as shown; null when blank (global notices). |
| `deadline_local` | string | Deadline in the agency's local time, ISO `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS` without offset. |
| `deadline_text` | string | Deadline exactly as shown, e.g. `08-Oct-2026 12:59 (GMT -4.00)`: agency local time with its GMT offset. |
| `deadline_utc` | string | Deadline converted to UTC, ISO `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`, from the shown local time and offset. |
| `deadline_utc_offset` | string | The GMT offset shown with the deadline, as `+HH:MM`/`-HH:MM`. |
| `notice_id` | number | UNGM notice id (`data-noticeid`), the key for get_notice. |
| `notice_type` | string | Type of opportunity label as shown (e.g. `Request for proposal`). |
| `published_on` | string | Publication date, ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`. |
| `reference` | string | Agency reference; null when the cell is blank. |
| `remaining_days` | number | Days until the deadline as computed by the site at response time (negative when expired); null when the site does not provide it. |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `title` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

200.description:
Search the UNSPSC category taxonomy UNGM uses to classify notices and awards, by keyword. Returns the matching categories with their UNGM node ids (the value search_notices takes in `unspsc_ids`), UNSPSC codes, titles, depth and whether each row is a match or an ancestor shown for context.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `records` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | string | UNSPSC code (`26111607`) or segment letter (`B`) at the top level. |
| `depth` | number | 0 = segment letter, 1 = segment code, 2 = family, 3 = class, 4 = commodity. |
| `is_match` | boolean | `true` for the categories matching the query; `false` for ancestors returned for context. |
| `node_id` | number | UNGM UNSPSC node id (`data-nodeid`), the filter value for search_notices. |
| `selectable` | boolean | Whether the site offers this node as a search filter (family level and below). |
| `title` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
